en: that I pull the boat along mid-stream?
that I may share a boat with the prince?
I do not mind reproach or disgrace.
My heart is troubled [?] and will not cease,
I have come to know the prince.
On the mountain there are trees, and the trees have branches;
my heart delights in you, my lord, and you do not know.
rom: xīn jī wán ér bù jué xī,
shān yǒu mù xī mù yǒu zhī,
xīn yuè jūn xī jūn bù zhī.
notes: 兮 (xī) is a sung particle with no meaning of its own; it is not translated.
2: 搴 is 'to pull, to lift'; the boat is pulled or poled along in the middle of the stream.
5: 蒙羞被好 is read as 'though shamed (of low station), I am favoured (by the prince)'.
6: 不訾詬恥, 'not reckoning reproach and shame': I do not mind being thought shameless.
8: 得知王子 can also be read 'that the prince might know (me)'.
9-10: 枝 (zhī, branch) sounds like 知 (zhī, to know): the trees have branches, but my lord does not know.
